basics.name: Anastasiia Volosevych
basics.label: Professional Worker
basics.summary: Motivated individual with experience in fast-paced environments, passionate about delivering reliable work and contributing to team goals. Strong communication and organizational skills developed through hands-on experience at Amazon and remote collaborations.

work.summary: Ensured priority packages were routed efficiently to meet strict deadlines. Solved problems in real-time to maintain workflow and collaborated with other team members to ensure smooth operations.
highlights: Handled time-sensitive deliveries and verified inventory accuracy.
Worked closely with team members and supervisors to resolve workflow issues.
Maintained a fast-paced work ethic and quality standards.

work.summary: Collaborated remotely with clients on small tasks, demonstrating strong communication, time management, and organizational skills in a freelance environment.
highlights: Managed freelance responsibilities while maintaining client satisfaction.
Delivered results within timeframes agreed upon.
Adapted quickly to various project requirements.

references.name: Kamel Greene
references.reference: I LOVED working with Anastasia. We had an immediate, easy rapport. She was so accommodating, so easy to work with, so responsive, and ultimately, so insightful and helpful. A total professional. My finished website exceeded my expectations.
